title: Arkret Recovery Receipt
description: Replacement-device-signed terminal intent for one RecoveryTransaction. It binds the two exact producer Event ids, recovery session/policy/proof snapshot and resulting device generation expectation. It is signed before authority admission and therefore does not contain a RealmCommit id; successful completion is proven separately by the coordinator-signed recovery completion attestation and its CommittedEventRef values.

transaction_id.description: RecoveryTransaction that reserved this receipt id. It MUST equal the transaction whose binding.terminal_receipt_id is this receipt_id, which is what lets a verifier holding only the receipt resolve the authorizing transaction; binding.terminal_receipt_id alone is one-way. See zh/identity/security-transactions.md section 2.

transaction_request_digest.description: Stable request_digest of the RecoveryTransaction. It is signed by the replacement device so the terminal attestation cannot be rebound to a different transaction plan even if an identifier is substituted.

prepared_plan_digest.description: Digest of the closed typed prepared_plan stored by the RecoveryTransaction. It MUST equal transaction.prepared_plan_digest and is signed to prevent substituting different prepared bytes under the same reserved ids.

account_id.description: Exact recovered AccountId. The replacement-device method proves only its principal projection; the accepted recovery session and device authorization independently bind this complete account, including station_id.

recovery_session_id.description: Stable session identifier used by every proof transcript, backup decrypt proof, and MLS Welcome replay during this recovery. A byte-identical resubmission of an already accepted receipt is idempotent and MUST return the stored receipt; only a SECOND, DIFFERENT receipt for the same session id and exact account is a conflict. Rejecting the byte-identical replay would make a lost response unrecoverable, which zh/identity/security-transactions.md section 1 invariants 3 and 4 forbid.

recovery_authority_kind.description: did_root is valid only when the accepted PCR policy explicitly enabled that optional factor.

previous_model_generation_ref.description: PCR device generation snapshotted at recovery-session creation.

result_model_generation_ref.description: Accepted monotonic PCR device generation after completion.

proof_digest.description: Canonical-JSON digest of the proof transcript used to satisfy the active recovery policy. Auditors recompute against the originating proof event to verify.

quorum_participant_count.description: Required for device_quorum; equals the number of distinct participating member devices.

welcome_count.description: Number of MLS Welcomes successfully replayed for the recovering device.

outcome_reason_code.description: Free-form reason code; MUST be present when outcome != 'completed'.

completed_at.description: Authoring time at which the replacement device signed 'complete this recovery if every check passes'. It is not proof that anything was committed. The durable, linearized commit time is the completed_at of the paired ak.schema.recovery_completion_attestation.v1, which MUST NOT be earlier than this value.

verification_method.description: DID URL of the new_device_id device key frozen by the recovery session and authorized by the recovery unit of this same transaction. Receivers MUST resolve it through the principal control stream and verify that the paired completion attestation reports the accepted ak.device.authorize; service keys and unrelated fresh-device keys MUST NOT sign a recovery_receipt.

signature_algorithm.description: v1 fixes the recovery-strand replacement device possession proof to Ed25519 (zh/crypto-media/device-lifecycle.md sections 5.2 and 14; transaction binding in zh/identity/security-transactions.md section 2). The three-algorithm set in zh/identity/key-management.md section 7.9 belongs to recovery_policy.method signing entries.alg and MUST NOT be reused as a reason to widen this one.

signature.description: base64url signature over UTF8('ak.identity.recovery_receipt.signature.v1\n') followed by RFC 8785 JCS of all present top-level receipt members except auth_data. The closed receipt shape fixes the projection; absent optional members are omitted and every present optional member is authenticated.
